mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dc3_driver_instance (tenant_id, driver_id, node_id, client_id, service_host, lease_until) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{node}, #{client}, #{host}, #{leaseUntil}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, driver_id, node_id) DO UPDATE SET client_id = EXCLUDED.client_id, service_host = EXCLUDED.service_host, last_heartbeat = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, lease_until = EXCLUDED.lease_until

INSERT INTO dc3_driver_instance (tenant_id, driver_id, node_id, client_id, service_host, lease_until) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{node}, #{client}, #{host}, #{leaseUntil}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE client_id = new.client_id, service_host = new.service_host, last_heartbeat = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), lease_until = new.lease_until

INSERT INTO dc3_driver_instance (tenant_id, driver_id, node_id, client_id, service_host, lease_until) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{node}, #{client}, #{host}, #{leaseUntil}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE client_id = VALUES(client_id), service_host = VALUES(service_host), last_heartbeat = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), lease_until = VALUES(lease_until)

INSERT INTO dc3_driver_lease_state (tenant_id, driver_id, membership_hash, device_revision) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{membershipHash}, #{deviceRevision}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, driver_id) DO UPDATE SET membership_hash = EXCLUDED.membership_hash, device_revision = EXCLUDED.device_revision, assignment_version = dc3_driver_lease_state.assignment_version + 1, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO dc3_driver_lease_state (tenant_id, driver_id, membership_hash, device_revision) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{membershipHash}, #{deviceRevision}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE membership_hash = new.membership_hash, device_revision = new.device_revision, assignment_version = dc3_driver_lease_state.assignment_version + 1, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO dc3_driver_lease_state (tenant_id, driver_id, membership_hash, device_revision) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{driverId}, #{membershipHash}, #{deviceRevision}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE membership_hash = VALUES(membership_hash), device_revision = VALUES(device_revision), assignment_version = dc3_driver_lease_state.assignment_version + 1, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

INSERT INTO dc3_device_lease (tenant_id, driver_id, device_id, owner_node) VALUES
(#{lease.tenantId}, #{lease.driverId}, #{lease.deviceId}, #{lease.ownerNode})
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, device_id) DO UPDATE SET driver_id = EXCLUDED.driver_id, owner_node = EXCLUDED.owner_node, fencing_token = dc3_device_lease.fencing_token + 1, operate_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE dc3_device_lease.driver_id != EXCLUDED.driver_id OR dc3_device_lease.owner_node != EXCLUDED.owner_node

INSERT INTO dc3_device_lease (tenant_id, driver_id, device_id, owner_node) VALUES
(#{lease.tenantId}, #{lease.driverId}, #{lease.deviceId}, #{lease.ownerNode}) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
fencing_token = IF(new.driver_id != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR new.owner_node != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, dc3_device_lease.fencing_token + 1, dc3_device_lease.fencing_token), operate_time = IF(new.driver_id != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR new.owner_node != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), dc3_device_lease.operate_time), driver_id = IF(new.driver_id != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR new.owner_node != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, new.driver_id, dc3_device_lease.driver_id), owner_node = IF(new.driver_id != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR new.owner_node != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, new.owner_node, dc3_device_lease.owner_node)

INSERT INTO dc3_device_lease (tenant_id, driver_id, device_id, owner_node) VALUES
(#{lease.tenantId}, #{lease.driverId}, #{lease.deviceId}, #{lease.ownerNode})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
fencing_token = IF(VALUES(driver_id) != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR VALUES(owner_node) != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, dc3_device_lease.fencing_token + 1, dc3_device_lease.fencing_token), operate_time = IF(VALUES(driver_id) != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR VALUES(owner_node) != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), dc3_device_lease.operate_time), driver_id = IF(VALUES(driver_id) != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR VALUES(owner_node) != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, VALUES(driver_id), dc3_device_lease.driver_id), owner_node = IF(VALUES(driver_id) != dc3_device_lease.driver_id OR VALUES(owner_node) != dc3_device_lease.owner_node, VALUES(owner_node), dc3_device_lease.owner_node)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dc3_device_lease lease WHERE lease.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lease.driver_id = #{driverId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dc3_device device WHERE device.tenant_id = lease.tenant_id AND device.id = lease.device_id AND device.driver_id = lease.driver_id AND device.deleted = 0 AND device.enable_flag = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT lease.tenant_id, lease.driver_id, lease.device_id, lease.owner_node, lease.fencing_token FROM dc3_device_lease lease JOIN dc3_driver_instance instance ON instance.tenant_id = lease.tenant_id AND instance.driver_id = lease.driver_id AND instance.node_id = lease.owner_node WHERE lease.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lease.device_id = #{deviceId} AND instance.lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
